Fellow Methusalehs:

Is there an official or prescribed order to the bidding resulting from
a Temptation of Greater Power?? There is no reference in the Rulings
page.

Also, our situation is a little unique, and that is why I ask.
Pallando (Osterreich), Xavier (Espana), Tat (Canada), and I (USA) are
playing in a Jyhad On Line game (#143) and Xavier just played a TGP.
The concern was raised that since we live in 4 different time zones,
chaotic real-time first-come-first-served bidding is not as equitable
as if we were seated around a real table.

Anyway, as moderator (a micro-LSJ if you will) I've taken Marcus'
suggestion that we should go clockwise from Xavier for bidding, but I
did want to check to see if there was an official ruling.

Thanks in advance,
Madman

Sent via Deja.com
http://www.deja.com/
